deliveryUnconfirmed.description: Negative fixture (section 8.4). The buyer archived the receipt document, the directory epoch, the SettleResponse and the accepted requirements of endToEnd, but captured no response body. It re-verifies after the issuer's result-recovery window has closed. The receipt is valid and the verifier holds a copy matching its digest (availability at the issuer's origin is not evaluated: there is no retrieval observation), the recovery window has closed (now >= until), and the buyer observed no output: delivery cannot be confirmed and the payment is not retried automatically. The recovery window is issuer policy, outside any signature; the values are synthetic. The window is open while now < until and closed from now >= until; the boundary runs in expectedVerdicts give now literally, at until - 1 and at until.
